create_average_meter: create an AverageMeter to track running averages of values with optional rounding
create_sum_meter: create a SumMeter to accumulate and store the sum of updated values
create_time_meter: create a TimeMeter to compute the average rate of events per second
create_stopwatch_meter: create a StopwatchMeter to measure the duration of events with start and stop
create_meters_dict: create a MetersDict to manage a priority-sorted collection of Meter instances
